Code Elevation Grids Into a Coded Terrain Field

Source: R/terrain.R
resolve.encode_terrain_grids.Rd

Compresses elevation grids with a bounded error: every cell is quantised to a multiple of 2 * maxError, so none moves by more than maxError, and each block of cells is coded on its own (Lorenzo prediction, as in the SZ error-bounded compressor, and Golomb-Rice codes with a run mode for flat ground). The result is a terrain field file that resolve.terrain_descriptors() and suites read like a neural field.

Usage

resolve.encode_terrain_grids(
  grids,
  path,
  maxError = 2,
  block = 64L,
  tiles = NULL
)

Arguments

grids

Directory of elevation grids (a tiles.json and its tiles).

path

Where the coded field is written.

maxError

Largest error a cell may carry, in m (default 2).

block

Cells per side of an independently coded block (default 64).

tiles

Names of the tiles to code; NULL codes every tile.

Value

A named list of tile -> metrics (RMSE, mean, 99th percentile and largest error in m, slope error in degrees, seconds, bytes), invisibly.
